parts.t: The Knight neighbourhood sits in a prime central position in East Vancouver, offering excellent connectivity to downtown, Richmond, and Burnaby. With a mix of single-family homes, duplexes, and condos, it's a practical and affordable choice for buyers who want to stay close to the city's core.
